meta.name: PiHub Borrower Investor-Parity DNA
meta.description: Borrower financing workflows rendered in the current PiHub Investor visual and interaction system. Figma remains a functional-flow reference only.

color.palette_type: cool institutional neutral with cobalt accent

secondary.role: global navigation rail and brand anchor

accent.role: small signal accents and current-state markers

neutral.usage: workspace surfaces, borders, secondary copy and primary text

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light workspace with a high-contrast midnight rail and WCAG-AA semantic pairs

font_families.heading: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
font_families.body: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
font_families.mono: IBM Plex Mono, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: institutional sans with tabular and mono treatment for money, dates, IDs and dense data

layout.columns: 12-column-capable content grid with 2-4 column dashboard compositions

elevation.depth_cues: borders, surface contrast and rare floating-menu shadows

iconography.preferred_set: PiHub outline SVG and Boxicons visual language

motion.entrance_pattern: 8-12px translate plus opacity and decisive ease-out
motion.philosophy: corporate functional motion with no bounce

components.button_style: 44px controls, 10px radius, cobalt primary and bordered white secondary
components.input_style: 44-48px white inputs with visible labels, neutral border and cobalt focus ring
components.card_style: white border-first surfaces with low shadow and compact headers
components.navigation_pattern: Investor-style persistent midnight rail plus 68px utility header
components.modal_style: 14px white floating surface with high shadow and explicit focus handling
components.list_style: dense scannable rows with subtle hover and explicit status
components.component_notes: Borrower reuses Investor geometry and interaction states; only workflow composition differs

visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: dark navigation balanced by light data surfaces
visual_language.focal_strategy: priority/action first and supporting data second

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic hierarchy plus spatial grouping and status accents
composition.flow_direction: top-left priority to right-side utilities then downward task progression
composition.grouping_strategy: cards, tapes, tables and rails grouped by workflow ownership
composition.negative_space_role: separates decision groups without making the dashboard hollow

imagery.graphic_elements: small SVG icons and status markers

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: 100-120ms border/background shift with no card zoom
interaction_feel.loading_style: skeleton or progress where needed and no decorative loops

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: explain what is missing and the next action

overview.fallback_strategy: direct static state under reduced motion or constrained devices

3d_elements.description: Three.js is intentionally excluded from dense operational routes and remains reserved for authentication or brand surfaces

image_effects.description: Avatar and content images do not distort

visual_effects.composite_notes: Use GSAP only where sequencing improves orientation, such as route entrance and the account menu. Three.js was reviewed and deliberately excluded from Borrower operational pages because WebGL adds GPU cost without improving task clarity.
